column1: -- SELECT po.code,po.status,poi.quantity_received,pr.id AS receipt_id,im.id AS movement_id,im.type,im.quantity,im.reference_type,im.reference_id FROM purchases po JOIN purchase_items poi ON poi.purchase_id=po.id LEFT JOIN purchase_receipts pr ON pr.purchase_id=po.id LEFT JOIN inventory_movements im ON im.reference_type='purchase_receipt' AND im.reference_id=pr.id WHERE po.id='cp-dashboard-v5-cp-compras-dev-purchase-8' ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC,im.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
